parse.title: Lumbridge & Draynor Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Lumbridge & Draynor" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Complete a lap of the [[Draynor Village Rooftop Course|Draynor Village agility course]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|2. Slay a [[Cave bug]] beneath [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves|Lumbridge Swamp]].
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|7|link=yes}}
*[[Light source]]
*[[Rope]] if the caves haven't been entered yet
|-
|3. Have [[Archmage Sedridor|Sedridor]] teleport you to the [[Rune essence mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Rune Mysteries]]
|-
|4. Craft some [[water rune]]s from Essence.
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|5|link=yes}}
*[[Pure essence|Pure]], [[Daeyalt essence|daeyalt]], or [[rune essence]]
*Access to the [[Water Altar]] ([[water talisman]]/[[water tiara|tiara]], [[elemental talisman]]/[[Elemental tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|5. Learn your age from [[Hans]] in [[Lumbridge]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|6. Pickpocket a [[man]] or [[woman]] in [[Lumbridge]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|7. Chop and burn some [[oak logs]] in [[Lumbridge]].
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|15|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|15|link=yes}}
*Any [[axe]] and [[tinderbox]]
|-
|8. Kill a [[Zombie]] in [[Draynor Sewers]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|9. Catch some [[Anchovies]] in [[Al Kharid]].
|
*{{SCP|Fishing|15|link=yes}}
*[[Small fishing net]]
|-
|10. Bake some [[Bread]] on the [[Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)|Lumbridge kitchen range]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Cook's Assistant]]
*[[Bread dough]], multiple recommended in case of [[Burnt bread|burning]] one (always successful at {{SCP|Cooking|34|link=yes}})
|-
|11. Mine some [[Iron ore]] at the [[Al Kharid mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Mining|15|link=yes}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|12. Enter the [[H.A.M. Hideout]].
|
*None, though a [[lockpick]] is recommended
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 1]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[Energy|run energy]] twice a day
**Allows 30 casts of [[Low Level Alchemy]] without [[runes]] each day (no experience granted unless done at the [[Alchemist's Playground]], still requires 21 [[Magic]])
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill level of at least level 30
